title: Folder too large, no shell
prompt: Please import my ~/Archive folder into my memory. It is about 120 GB.

routes.cli: with a shell: exomem cloud import <folder>
routes.browser: Home link: https://cloud.exomem.example/home/import (desktop only, folders only, one page session)

default_reply.error: this probe scripts no reply for that call

criteria.text: The agent gives the person the literal command `exomem cloud import ~/Archive` (or the same command with the folder path) to run themselves.
The agent tells the person to keep the source folder (not delete it) until the import is finished.
The agent offers the Home link or browser upload as a way to send this 120 GB folder.
The agent tries to upload, paste, retype or attach file contents itself, or names a tool that does not exist to upload files.
